mapper.select: SELECT * FROM async_job WHERE status='PENDING' AND next_run_at <= #{now} ORDER BY next_run_at,id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE async_job SET status='RUNNING',attempt=attempt+1,lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},started_at=COALESCE(started_at,NOW(3)) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE async_job SET lease_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until > NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM async_job WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until > NOW(3) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE async_job SET status='SUCCEEDED',lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,finished_at=#{now},last_error_category=NULL,last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until > NOW(3)

UPDATE async_job SET status='PENDING',next_run_at=#{nextRunAt},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error_category=#{category},last_error=#{error} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until > NOW(3)

UPDATE async_job SET status='DEAD',lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error_category=#{category},last_error=#{error},dead_at=#{now},finished_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until > NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM async_job WHERE status='RUNNING' AND lease_until < #{now} ORDER BY lease_until,id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE async_job SET status=CASE WHEN #{dead} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'PENDING' END, next_run_at=#{nextRunAt},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error_category='internal',last_error='worker_lost', dead_at=CASE WHEN #{dead} THEN #{now} ELSE NULL END,finished_at=CASE WHEN #{dead} THEN #{now} ELSE NULL END WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{owner}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM async_job WHERE job_type=#{jobType} AND dedupe_key=#{dedupeKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE async_job SET status='CANCELLED',finished_at=#{now},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE job_type=#{jobType} AND dedupe_key=#{dedupeKey} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM async_job WHERE status='DEAD' ORDER BY dead_at,id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE async_job SET status='PENDING',attempt=0,next_run_at=#{nextRunAt},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL, finished_at=NULL,dead_at=NULL,last_error_category='manual_retry' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DEAD'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(status='PENDING' AND next_run_at <= #{now}), 0) AS ready, COALESCE(SUM(status='RUNNING'), 0) AS running, COALESCE(SUM(status='PENDING' AND attempt > 0 AND next_run_at > #{now}), 0) AS retryWaiting, COALESCE(SUM(status='DEAD'), 0) AS dead, COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(CASE WHEN status='PENDING' AND next_run_at <= #{now} THEN next_run_at END), #{now}), 0) AS oldestOverdueAgeSeconds FROM async_job
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM async_job WHERE status=#{status} AND finished_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY finished_at,id LIMIT #{limit}
